channel.title: Rip-Off Britain
channel.desc: The team hears from the homeowner left footing the bill after the adjoining house caught fire - and reveals what a similar no-fault claim could mean for your insurance premium. Also on the programme, the patients landed with parking tickets after visiting their GP, and why it's on the rise. And expert advice for the customer whose bank doesn't believe he was a victim of fraud.
